// diagnostic

E3540

One {command} command has multiple overrides: {locations}.

What

One {command} command has multiple overrides: {locations}.

Why

A command scope can select one override or the stock default, but multiple overrides are ambiguous.

Fix

Keep one fn {command} in the package scope, or remove the other command override.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3540: tests/ui/command_override_conflict/stderr.

Error [jet.DuplicateCommandOverride]: One run command has multiple overrides: `run.jet:2`, `a.jet:1` and `b.jet:1`.
 Why: A command scope can select one override or the stock default, but multiple overrides are ambiguous.
 Fix: Keep one fn run in the package scope, or remove the other command override.
